subject: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps (Acme)

Hi Emily / team 

thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed plan to keep momentum: 

Attendees (Acme): Emily Zhang (VP Product), Tom Nguyen (Procurement), Sarah Lopez (Legal), Michael Chen (Data Platform).
Attendees (Redwood): Marissa Cole (AE), Rishi Malhotra (SE), Lauren Bishop (CS/Onboarding).

Key decision criteria called out on the call:
- Performance & latency for 2k concurrent inference sessions (p95 < 150ms)
- Data residency & controls (must support VPC/private deployment and KMS)
- Cost per 1M tokens + predictable committed capacity options
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC2, encryption, retention)

Economic buyer: Emily indicated final sign-off will come from her (VP Product) with procurement (Tom) owning PO terms.
Security/legal/procurement next steps:
- We will send SOC2 evidence and data retention policy (attached).
- Procurement requested a commercial proposal and sample PO/terms (attached: Acme-Proposal-ACME-2027-045.pdf).

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline):
1) Rishi to share SOC2 & technical FAQ + confirm private deployment options 

by EOD 4/19.
2) Lauren to coordinate procurement conversation and gather PO/term requirements 


allocate schedule for week of 4/22.
3) Marissa to send finalized commercial quote and DocuSign envelope once legal/procurement confirm terms.

Desired decision timeline: Emily said target is to decide by the first week of May (week of 5/3) 

we'll treat that as our target.

Attachments: Acme-Proposal-ACME-2027-045.pdf (proposal), Redwood-Private-Deployment-FAQ.pdf (tech FAQ)
Related links: HubSpot deal https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/ACME-2027-045

If that looks right, I'll coordinate the procurement meeting and get Rishi to send the SOC2 artifact.

Thanks 
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, Sarah Lopez <s.lopez@acme.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps (Acme)

Marissa 

thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. A few quick things from our side:

1) Security/legal will need SOC2 Type II and a short summary of retention/encryption (KMS) + any customer-managed key options.
2) Procurement (Tom) will want to see sample PO language and standard Net30 or Net45 options; we'll also need any standard SLAs and remedies documented.
3) On decision timeline 


we are targeting early May but legal needs at least one full week to review contract redlines.

Can Rishi send the SOC2 artifact and a one-page tech note describing VPC/private deployment + KMS options? That will help us get legal/security comfortable ahead of procurement.

Also looping Sarah (Legal) & Tom (Procurement) 


Sarah, Tom: feel free to add items I missed.

Best,
Emily
VP Product, Acme Corp

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lopez <s.lopez@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps (Acme)

Emily / team 

thanks for the clear asks. Attached is the SOC2 Type II artifact (Redwood-SOC2-TypeII.pdf) and a short tech note summarizing private deployment + KMS/options. Highlights below: 

- SOC2: Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II (controls over infra, change mgmt, access) 


we can arrange vendor-validated evidence under NDA if needed.
- Data residency/KMS: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For Private deployments we provide a customer-controlled VPC with options for on-prem air-gapped install.
- SLA/uptime: For Dedicated customers we offer a 99.9% uptime SLA with per-month credits on breach; hosted API SLA options available for enterprise.
- Performance: On the demo we showed p95 ~ 120ms at the demonstrated load; we will generate a short perf profile for your specific 2k concurrent sessions by 4/21 if you'd like.

Next steps (concrete owners):
- Rishi: provide perf profile + technical FAQ by 4/21.
- Lauren: lead procurement scheduling and collect PO/term preferences (Net30/Net45, tax info) 


Lauren will propose 2x time slots for week of 4/22.
- Marissa: finalize commercial based on any discount/commit requests; will send DocuSign link once terms confirmed.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII.pdf, Redwood-Private-Deployment-FAQ.pdf

Happy to hop on a technical call with your security team 


suggest Thu 4/22 10:00am PT or Fri 4/23 9:00am PT. Lauren, Vivek 


can you confirm availability for the procurement/discount discussion?

Thanks 
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lopez <s.lopez@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps (Acme)

Marissa / Lauren 

thanks. Thu 4/22 10:00am PT works for procurement + security touchpoint. Couple of items for your team to prepare before the call:

- Sample PO / standard terms (we typically start with Net30). If you have a standard redline we can send that in advance, please attach.
- Any standard marketplace/partner references for SOW/usage evidence (we use those for procurement vetting).
- Point of contact for contract/legal (Sarah will own the review, but please confirm who we should expect as Redwood legal).

Lauren 
will propose a calendar invite for Thu 4/22 10:00am PT and include a short agenda: 1) Legal/PO items 2) Pricing/commit options 3) Timeline to sign.

Marissa 

once legal terms are aligned, we can accept the DocuSign envelope. If you can send the DocuSign link or the quote by EOD 4/22 that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Head of Procurement | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
